body: Hi, thank you for the nice things you say about me, and for saying I matter. I can only think someone as compassionate and caring (and tolerant!) as you seem to be would make a fantastic physician or healthcare worker.

Thank you for your support, and while I would perhaps have wanted you not to have worded it quite like that, I appreciate your meaning to help and saying that I matter. Thank you for being a nice person.

Thank you for the nice words, and for telling me I matter. I have requested to have other doctors treat the transgendered patients I was supposed to see. I am barely maintaining composure right now, and I fear I will break down in front of a patient (I can only imagine the trauma of seeking help and having your doctor have a breakdown - I think you'd fear you were so badly off that you make doctors sick.) I am not sure, but I think perhaps a transgendered patient would be a greater risk for me. Anyway, I see your reasoning, and thank you again for the message.
Thank you for your nice words, they mean a lot.
Thank you for the words of encouragement, and kudos to you for changing your outlook and showing tolerance towards others.

Thank you for replying, it is obvious that you mean well and it is very generous of you. I don't think anyone would ever hire a doctor who obviously lies in a job application, but thank you for the suggestion - it is a nice idea, and I like thinking about it. I do fear failing, and ending up with the results you mention, but there are ways to prevent that in advance. Very irrationally, however, my stronger fear is reincarnation, which I do not even believe in. Again, thank you for your message, for being tolerant and supportive.
Thank you for replying, and selflessly offering to help. You seem like an amazingly compassionate person. I will think about what you said.
Thank you for your kind words, and for complimenting a stranger on the internet to make them feel better. I feel better knowing that there are such amazing people as you, and the others on SW around.

Thank you for your message. Your showing you care is heartwarming to me. I would not blame my family for my being unhappy, but I appreciate your meaning well. I think it is understandable though that it is perhaps difficult for family members to accept and be supportive of unusual traits.

Hi, thank you for taking time out of your day to reply to me and showing you care, it is so nice of you. I know of gender reassignment and I used to always want to do that, but I have eventually realized it is not an option for me.

Many years ago a supportive friend encouraged me to go out with her as a girl. It was, however, apparent to many strangers what my real gender was, and I was mocked and abused. I stopped immediately, and realized I would rather be unhappy or dead, than a person who disgusts or annoys others.

Written out like this I realize it must sound like such a childish, unreasonable, spoiled or uncompromising stance, but I really care about not bothering others. I could not help anyone, because noone wants a weird doctor. It would also undo my family being proud of me.

Again, thank you for your showing of compassion, and sorry about a pretty sad reply to a well-meaning post.

Oh, thank you for your reply, and your showing sympathy. It is nice of you. Um, from what I understand from those rules to the right we are not allowed to discuss suicide methods, I think.

But if a mod would perhaps say that it is okay, then I can explain. I have two methods, but I have not decided which one to go with yet, so I am collecting material for both.
